pearls.purpose: Holds the canonical domain template for a ccash constellation: jurisdictions, regulatory profile, station tree, default risk policies. Operator ccash grains Powerbox-claim this Pearl's TemplateService cap (capnp TypeID 0xf1e2d3c4b5a69780) to seed their own setup; updates here propagate to all consumers on next request via mtime-aware cache.

sidecars.label: Grain Crypto Journal
sidecars.purpose: Templates are plain YAML on disk — no operator-private secrets to encrypt.

sidecars.label: Grain Restore
sidecars.purpose: State is the YAML files on disk; restore = standard grain backup.

sidecars.label: Cap'n Proto WebSession
sidecars.purpose: TemplateService is exposed via raw capnp; consumed by ccash grains over Powerbox.

offers.name: domain-template
offers.purpose: Read the canonical template — jurisdictions, station tree, default policies.

offers.name: station-template
offers.purpose: Pick a station template (per-jurisdiction) at workspace setup time.

adminOnly.name: Update domain templates
adminOnly.purpose: Owner pushes new YAML; consumers see the change on their next request.

anyMember.name: Read templates
anyMember.purpose: Anyone with a Powerbox claim can read.

blockchains.purpose: Release attestation only; this Pearl makes no other on-chain calls.

incomingApi.purpose: Template service for the ccash constellation.
